# Famlo Help Center

> Famlo is where families find local activities, classes and community, and
> where the organizations serving them (co-ops, microschools, tutors, venues,
> parent groups) list programs, take bookings, run their community, and can run
> their own website.

A Famlo account is free for families, and free events are free. Paid bookings
include a booking fee of 3.7% of the price plus $1.79 a ticket, plus payment
processing, already in the price shown; an organization can choose to pay it
instead. Organizations list and run their community for free; the Scholarship
plan ($49 a month) adds Step Up and ESA invoicing, and the Website plan ($99 a
month or $990 a year) adds their own website on their own domain. Current
prices: https://famlo.co/pricing
